Alpha Lucky

The work

Infrastructure for
decisions that are questioned.

Most software is built to be used. Alpha Lucky Chukwunwike Okechukwu builds software to be examined. His systems are designed for the moment after a decision is made, when a regulator, a lender, a board or a member of the public asks why it was made that way and what happened next.

That requirement shapes the architecture. Every platform he has founded preserves four things as separate, inspectable records: the evidence, the rule that applied, the authority under which action was taken, and what changed afterwards. It is a harder way to build. It is the only way the result survives scrutiny.

He works as the architect of each system rather than only its owner, across identity and verification, financial trust and credit decisioning, platform assurance, experience and accountability, route operations and practical capability.

How he works

Refuse the easier option.

Three rules govern the engineering across every platform. Never weaken one part of a system to make another part pass. Never take the easier option when the harder one is correct. Never let a finding be owned by nobody.

They sound like principles. In practice they are build decisions: a duplicate participant is refused rather than quietly accepted, a check that cannot pass is fixed at its cause rather than switched off, and a system that returns nothing is proven to still serve the person entitled to see something.

It is why the systems can be sold to buyers who will be cross-examined about a number.

Who is Alpha Lucky Chukwunwike Okechukwu?

Alpha Lucky Chukwunwike Okechukwu is an infrastructure and enterprise architect and the founder of AlphaIT Engineering, LisBon Platforms and LisBonFARM. He designs and builds the operating infrastructure behind financial trust, organisational execution, platform assurance, movement and agro-industrial production.

What has Alpha Lucky Okechukwu built?

He is the founder and architect of every AlphaIT system: Verdika, Varren, Varren Aegis, Varren Herald, LisBon Signal Infrastructure, LisBon Trust Infrastructure, LisCredit Marketplace, Trust App, LisBon Flow Infrastructure, Flow App and Pollenair. He is also the sponsor of AgroGlobal ICPI, a 1,200 tonne-per-day cassava processing facility in Edo State, Nigeria.

What companies does Alpha Lucky Okechukwu run?

AlphaIT Engineering, a product engineering company contracting through Alpha Innovation Technologies - F.Z.C in the United Arab Emirates and Alpha Innovation Technologies Ltd in Nigeria; LisBon Platforms, a multi-sector infrastructure group; and LisBonFARM, the agro-industrial infrastructure platform whose issuer is LISBONFARM LTD, registered in Nigeria under RC 8508608.

What is Alpha Lucky Okechukwu known for professionally?

Building governed systems rather than demonstrations. Each of his platforms preserves the evidence, the authority under which an action was taken and the record of what changed afterwards, so a decision can be explained, replayed and defended under cross-examination.

Where does Alpha Lucky Okechukwu work?

Across Nigeria, Kenya and the United Arab Emirates, with AlphaIT Engineering operating from Ajman Free Zone, Nairobi and Lagos.

How can Alpha Lucky Okechukwu be contacted?

Through AlphaIT Engineering at projects@alphaitengineering.com.
